column1: # Chat emoji corpus (QA-owned). Used by ChatFilterCorpusQaTest and the server chat tests.
# Columns: id, expect, input, must_remain ('|' separated substrings that must survive, '-' = none), exact (the exact cleaned
# expect: KEEP         cleaned text == input exactly.
#         STRIP        cleaned text (if accepted) contains no forbidden code point (QaTextOracle.isForbiddenInChat) and every
#                      must_remain; if must_remain is '-' the server may also answer chat_empty.
#         CLEANED      universal chat invariants hold (QaTextOracle.chatViolations), must_remain survive, exact if given.
#         REJECT_EMPTY server answers error chat_empty, nothing is broadcast.
#         REJECT_LONG  server answers error chat_too_long (more than 100 code points AFTER cleaning), nothing is broadcast.
# Spec: docs/protocol.md 9.1 (emoji, control and zero-width characters removed, whitespace collapsed, trimmed, 100 code points).
# QA definition of "emoji" (DEFECTS.md DEF-006): any Emoji_Presentation code point, anything in U+1F000..U+1FAFF, regional
# indicators, skin-tone modifiers, U+FE0F, U+20E3, U+200D and tag characters. Text-presentation symbols WITHOUT U+FE0F
# (heart suit, copyright, trade mark, music note, stars, arrows, check mark) are text and must survive.
# Format: UTF-8, tab-separated, '#' starts a comment line, first non-comment line is the header.
# Escapes in text columns (decoded by the QA loaders, QaCorpus.kt):
#   \R[N:TEXT] repeats TEXT N times (inside TEXT write \] for ']').
# Invisible, control, bidi and confusable characters are ALWAYS written as escapes so a reviewer can see them;
# QaCorporaWellFormedTest fails if a raw invisible/control/bidi character appears in this file.
